definition.en: A period of changes in production and power, beginning with Britain in this topic; other regions changed at different times.
definition.zh: 本题用来描述先从英国讲起的生产与动力变化，各地并不同步。

definition.en: Using machines to perform production tasks; machines need not use steam.
definition.zh: 用机器完成生产任务；机器未必靠蒸汽。

definition.en: Making yarn; it is a different task from weaving cloth.
definition.zh: 做出纱线，与把纱线织成布的工作不同。

definition.en: Crossing weft yarn with warp yarns to make cloth; a shuttle carries the weft.
definition.zh: 把纬纱与经纱交织成布；梭子带着纬纱穿行。

definition.en: A place where workers and machinery are brought together for production; early factories could use water power.
definition.zh: 把工人与机器集中起来生产的场所；早期工厂也能用水力。

definition.en: An engine using steam and pressure differences to move machinery.
definition.zh: 利用蒸汽及压力差带动机械的动力装置。

definition.en: Steam changes to liquid water; in these early engines this lowers pressure.
definition.zh: 蒸汽变回液态水；在这些早期机器中，冷凝使压力降低。

definition.en: A region containing coal-bearing rocks, not a list of mines operating in a particular year.
definition.zh: 含有煤层的地区，不等于某年正在开采的煤矿清单。

definition.en: A vessel using a steam engine for propulsion; it is distinguished from a sailing vessel in the harbour records.
definition.zh: 以蒸汽机推动的船，在本题码头记录中与帆船分开统计。

definition.en: Sending messages by electrical signals; a manual key makes and breaks a circuit.
definition.zh: 用电信号传递消息；手控电键接通、断开电路。

definition.en: A material used to insulate submarine telegraph cables, distinct from plantation rubber in this topic.
definition.zh: 海底电报电缆所用的绝缘材料，与本题种植园橡胶分开。

definition.en: A system in which people were treated as property and compelled to work; slave-grown cotton supplied mechanised manufacture.
definition.zh: 把人当作财产、强迫劳动的制度；被奴役者种出的棉花供给机械化制造。

definition.en: A labour arrangement binding a worker to an employer for a period; contracts, recruitment and debt could restrict freedom.
definition.zh: 工人在一定期限内受雇佣契约约束的安排；契约、招工与债务可能限制自由。

definition.en: Recruitment through an overseer, one of several systems used for Indian labour migration to Malaya.
definition.zh: 通过工头招募劳工，是印度劳工迁往马来亚的招工方式之一。

definition.en: A decline in manufacturing activity in a defined sector or region; Indian experiences differed across industries and places.
definition.zh: 某行业或地区制造活动的衰退；印度各行业、各地经历并不相同。
